{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Tailored wool-blend blazer, structured fit, knee-length hem, charcoal gray (#36454F), heavy woven fabric.
Silk-cotton blend blouse, relaxed collar, mid-thigh length, cream white (#FFFDD0), lightweight fluid fabric.
High-waisted pleated trousers, straight cut, ankle length with a slight break, oatmeal beige (#EADDC2), crisp cotton fabric.
Leather loafers, classic cap-toe design, mid-height sole, deep brown (#654321), smooth genuine leather.
Thin silk scarf in rust orange (#B7410E), lightweight woven material to add a touch of autumn color without being overwhelming.

This outfit works because the blazer and pleated trousers immediately establish the professional yet relaxed tone required for a "neat" office environment. The cream blouse provides a soft contrast to the darker outer layers, while the rust orange scarf introduces a warm seasonal element perfect for an autumn day without sacrificing business appropriateness. Loafers offer comfort for a full workday while maintaining a polished silhouette that aligns with daytime daylight conditions."}
